name: AgentPause post-task probe
citation: AgentPause project (2026). Ad-hoc items for piloting; NOT a validated instrument.
construct: perceived control, interruption appropriateness, understanding, trust (single items)

items.text: I felt in control of what the agent did.
The agent asked for my input at appropriate moments.
I would rather have been asked earlier or later than I was.
I understood why the agent asked me what it asked.
I would trust this agent to act on my behalf in similar tasks.
I feel responsible for the outcome of this task.

notes: Single-item measures for piloting and manipulation checks. Pre-register them, report them as non-validated, and pair them with a validated instrument of your choice (see docs/experiments.md).
